fusions.name: Split Call
fusions.desc: Sends a sonic pulse into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 resonating damage. It then forks to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Divided Chord
fusions.desc: Looses 2 sonic pulses in a spread, each dealing 10 resonating damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Crossroads
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second bolt forks to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 lightning damage. Once every 6 seconds.
